LESSON: READING 8.2.1 INTENSIVE READING: POEM

Grade: SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade 8
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 8
Topic 8.2: Reading 8.2.1 Intensive Reading: Poem
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Reading 8.2.1 Intensive Reading: Poem, part of Strand 8 in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade 8 ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: How can one tell the meaning of unfamiliar words used in a text? 2. Why should one support an opinion about a story or person with evidence?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

A. select required information from a text,

4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.
